notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 available time-advance services at the inclusive GALT boundary. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies timestamped interaction delivery through Time Advance Request Available and Next Message Request Available, boundary ordering, retraction metadata, and grant servicing without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador available time-advance services with timestamped interaction delivery and FederateAmbassador grant callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador timeAdvanceRequestAvailable and nextMessageRequestAvailable declarations
